title: Blog With Author Accounts
originalPrompt: I want a blog where registered authors can write and publish posts, and only the author who wrote a post can edit it.

components.name: Post Feed
components.purpose: Shows recent blog posts in reverse chronological order.

components.name: Post Editor
components.purpose: Rich text editor for drafting and publishing a post.

components.name: Posts API
components.purpose: CRUD endpoints for blog posts, publish/unpublish.

components.name: Auth Service
components.purpose: Issues and verifies session tokens on login.

components.name: posts table
components.purpose: Stores post title, body, author_id, and published flag.

components.name: users table
components.purpose: Stores user email and hashed password.

components.name: Author Ownership Check
components.purpose: Rejects edits to a post from any user other than its author.

constraints.rawText: The backend sits above the database and is the only layer that queries it.
